<thought>Only carbon shows a clear, strong M+1 isotopic envelope (~16% of the monoisotopic peak) consistent with many 13C atoms, which is unambiguous. No other element exhibits a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl or Br M+2 ≈33‑100% or S M+2 ≈4% alone) that can be definitively distinguished from the carbon‑based pattern. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
